# DIMES-BI

> Bring-your-own-data (BYOD) MEAL analytics and dashboarding — connect Kobo, Excel, SurveyCTO, Google Forms, Microsoft 365, CSV, and APIs; build indicators, dashboards, maps, and narrative reports in one workspace.

DIMES-BI is for NGOs, humanitarian programs, research teams, and government MEAL units that collect data in many tools but need one trusted place to analyze, visualize, and report.

## Primary actions

- Try the workspace: /dashboards/add
- Import data: /data-management/import
- View dashboards: /dashboards

## Core capabilities

- No-code indicator formulas and cross-dataset queries
- Dashboard builder: charts, maps, KPIs, tables, narrative blocks
- MEAL workflows: baselines, targets, disaggregation, feedback, snapshots
- Scheduled refresh, alerts, PDF/PowerPoint export, shareable links
